name: minimal-card

frames.best_why: Card is whole against black with the photo and all three description lines unobstructed.

tagline: A soft dark card holding a photo, title and short copy.
summary: A rounded dark card with a photo filling its top and a title plus three lines of muted text beneath. Its only change is a slight lightening of the surface when hovered.
appearance: A tall dark card with generously rounded corners sits on black. A wide photo of snowy peaks above a sea of cloud fills the top, with a white title and three lines of grey body text below.
behaviour: Almost still: the only change is a faint lightening of the card surface while the pointer rests on it. Nothing moves on its own.
demo_content: Photo of snowy peaks above clouds, titled Mountain Escape, with copy about an alpine retreat.
search_phrases: simple card with image and text
tile for a grid of articles
soft shadow card for a landing page
use_when: A grid of articles or places needs a calm, low-chrome tile people can scan.
avoid_when: The image is fixed at 190px tall and there are no slots for prices or actions.
customise: Card, image, title, description, content and footer are separate exports; className tunes each part, the image takes src and alt, and copy goes in as children.
weight_why: A small div tree with CSS shadows and a colour transition; no script.

a11y.note: The image alt is a required prop, but the card is a plain div so nothing here is focusable.

issues: The grey description text is low contrast against the dark card surface.
polish_why: Even rounding and a soft shadow; image and copy are well spaced but the styling is standard.
